page.layout: One printed page, a title page. Title block at the top centre in large capitals, with a smaller title block below it, and a woodcut ornament at the right of the middle. Below the ornament, the lines of text run down to the right and left with a short line at the foot. The faint mirrored text (show-through from the other side) and the handwritten number at the foot are not transcribed.
page.notes: Most of the title is very faint, and much of it is show-through from the reverse side, so the lines above are only partly legible. The top title lines and the central block are largely illegible. The ornament at the right is a woodcut and has no text. The handwritten number at the foot and the dark ink stains are not printed text and were left out.
